svg.text: NB1 pod carrier rev C, assembly (parts side, rear of the pod)

Shaded bodies are the parts at true size, colours match the BOM. Gold pads: bottom solder. Orange pads: top-side chip parts. Coloured rings: vias, see the key below. Double black rings: component leads soldered on both sides. Red dashes: top copper.
J1 pins 1-8: AIN2, AIN1, unused, CAN_TX, CAN_RX, 3V3, GND, 5V (pin 1 = IO18 end, left). Solder D1 pin 1, D2 pin 1 and the top end of R2 on BOTH sides.
Inset, 2x: sensor cluster, top side (x -20 to -4 mm, y -10 to 0 mm)
body on top, pins through into the Waveshare socket
car: 1 GND, 2 LIGHTS, 3 CAN L, 4 CAN H, 5 12 V
to Waveshare EX0 / SDA / SCL test pads
socket pin 1 = CANL at the left
band left; solder pin 1 on BOTH sides
band left; solder pin 1 on BOTH sides
solder the TOP end on both sides
CAN RX series, body over CAN TX
TOP side; bridged = resistive sender, open = 0-5 V
copper rivet or a trimmed resistor lead
solder both sides first; colours in the via key
Waveshare back to carrier copper face

g.text: Via key (parts-side view, mm from centre): nine wire vias, each its own colour, and the three component leads that double as vias
